text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired: auth-service - high rate of JWT validation errors (500s). Auto-escalation to SRE and Auth owners. Pager ID pd_abbc1234.

pagerduty: Pager acknowledged by maria. ETA to respond: 2m.

maria: I'm on it, checking logs and recent deploys. Noting spike at 14:12 UTC.

sam: any deploys to auth-service in the last 10m?

maria: I see a deploy from earlier today at 13:45 but nothing at 14:10. Pulling logs now.

alex: I can check the JWKS propagation logs. Saw a config push to key-service ~13:55 that might not have propagated to all edge validators.

maria: stack traces show `kid` mismatch on token validation: token.kid=key-v2, validator expects key-v1 -> returns 500. So signing key rotation looks partially applied.

jess: oh — we rolled key-v2 but didn't include backwards compatibility header for a short window. Did the key-service set `x-allow-legacy-kid`?

alex: it didn't. Key-service PR only set new public key and updated metadata, but the validator cache refresh failed on 3/5 validator pods due to a transient DNS timeout.

maria: mitigation plan: 1) re-enable fallback to previous public key in validators; 2) force cache refresh; 3) backfill metrics and check customer impact. Propose temporary `auth.config.allow_legacy=true` toggle.

sam: +1. Can we patch validators without full deploy? Maybe via config push to Consul/ConfigMap.

alex: I can push a config flip to the 5 validator pods now and then force rolling restart of the 3 that still erroring. Command: `kubectl patch cm auth-validators --patch '{"data":{"allow_legacy":"true"}}'` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-validator -n prod`.

maria: Doing config patch now. Will monitor error rate.

deploy-bot: @maria executed `kubectl patch cm auth-validators` (run by maria).

maria: patched. Waiting for pods to pick up config.

oncall-rotation: handing off to sam for primary response, I can stay on for customer comms.

sam: taking over. Running `kubectl get pods -l app=auth-validator -n prod` to find failing pods.

sam: 3 pods still showing `CrashLoopBackOff` with validation errors in logs. Starting `rollout restart` now.

alex: I'll monitor JWKS propagation and run a manual `curl` against key-service metadata endpoint on each zone: `curl -s https://keys.internal.redwood/v1/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'`.

maria: Error rate dropped from 18% to 2% after the restart on the 3 pods. Metrics: auth.validate.errors 18% -> 2% in 6m.

jess: nice. For postmortem we should add a pre-flight check for cache hydration and an automated graceful fallback when new KID appears.

sam: Customer impact: short window (~8m) where token validations returned 500s causing API requests to fail for customers using freshly minted tokens. I flagged high-volume tenant corp-acme and support ticket #T-5421.

maria: CC support, can you prepare an incident banner and a short customer note? Keep it factual: "Intermittent auth failures for new sessions due to key rotation propagation — issue mitigated, no tokens exposed."

oncall-rotation: I'll draft the banner and ping legal for wording.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline check: last key-service change deployed at 13:55 by jess — CI job id ci-9087. No follow-up smoke check was configured.

jess: noted. Action items: (1) add smoke test to key-service deploy that verifies JWKS propagation to validators; (2) add fallback feature flag for 1-hour compatibility after key rotation; (3) update runbook to include quick `kubectl patch` steps.

alex: Also adding a health check endpoint to validators to report `jwks_last_refresh` and `current_known_kids`. Makes triage easier.

maria: I'll open an incident ticket and assign owners. Severity: Sev2 - customer impact but mitigated.

sam: Monitoring: added alert suppression for duplicate pager noise and set a 5m cooldown on the same error class to avoid repeat pages during mitigation.

maria: Final status: rollout complete, error rate back to baseline (0.1%). Leaving incident channel open for any regressions; will run a 24h watch and create a PM for the reliability work. :white_check_mark:

jess: Thanks team. Filing postmortem draft.

pagerduty: Pager resolved by maria at 2112348400.

incident-bot: Incident channel archived in 24h unless reopened.
